additional_corrections.rule: A timeout/disconnect after any request bytes may represent delivered-but-unacknowledged. Persist SENDING before network. Persist Delivered only from valid response; definite rejection as Failed; ambiguous outcome as Uncertain. No automatic retry from SENDING/Uncertain after restart. Stable local request identity prevents duplicate local dispatch but cannot create exactly-once remote API semantics.
additional_corrections.acceptance: Drop response after server accepts synthetic send; restart consumer; observe one recorded server attempt and durable Uncertain, no second send and no fabricated failure/delivery.

additional_corrections.rule: file_id and file_unique_id are opaque strings; do not promise lexical discrimination. Expose distinct typed values and bind send-by-reference to known authenticated bot-scoped media metadata. A raw arbitrary string cannot mint a trusted resend reference.
additional_corrections.acceptance: Wrong tagged reference or wrong bot refused before network; unknown/invalid upstream file reference produces typed API rejection without reflection.

additional_corrections.rule: A file_id is scoped to a bot and media type; reused content cannot silently change type or adopt another bot's ID. Validate method-specific bounds and metadata.

Bootstrap storage and capacity reservation precede both downloads and sends; no blob bytes enter the bounded native KV rows. Blob storage uses bounded separate files, private permissions, symlink refusal, cleanup and retention with intent references.
Source-only review establishes misleading claims, not the absence of every possible external/runtime vote consumer. Operational proof remains required.
